title: 09 · Onboarding stepper · Mossby
strengths: A real idea: the progress line is a vine that sprouts a leaf per finished step, and 'I'm not sure yet' is on every question
The drawings are real CC0 line art (CocoMaterial) recoloured through the tokens, not emoji; the card copy is specific ('Forgives forgetting', 'Water once a month', 'Search 900+ plants')
States are complete: six step-node states, four Continue states, a phone variant, the 'tried to skip a required step' message and the step-4 card
slop_signals: Line art on a pastel blob inside every card (sage, sand, peach, lilac): the icon-on-coloured-blob template, with a different hue per card so four pastels plus green, butter and terracotta share one screen
Decorative pastel blob shapes in the page corners (peach bottom-left, sand bottom-centre, lilac top-right, peach bottom-right)
Green check discs on the card corners and a green pill 'Continue 2' with a counter disc inside: two pill badges for one count
Fredoka at 56 px for 'Who already lives with you?' pushes the voice toward a children's app
fixes: Remove the page-corner blobs; keep the page white or one pale sage
Use one blob tint for all cards (sage) or no blob at all, letting the ink drawing sit on white as Remote does
Replace the corner check disc with a 2 px sage border plus a small check in the title row; drop the counter disc inside Continue
Bring the display size down one step (to 45 px) and set it in Nunito 700 as a test next to Fredoka

references.what: Illustrated choice cards on white with a single blue; a numbered step strip at the top and 'Skip this' beside Continue
Text choice cards with a sub-line and a checkbox; the illustration lives beside the form, not inside every card
'STEP 3 OF 6' as a segmented bar and single-line option cards; the compact pattern our phone variant uses
Image cards with a check in the corner and a Back / Next pair under a 'STEP 2 OF 3' overline

round4.pairwise: Mercury/ElevenLabs/Remote: round 1 +3/+3/+3, round 2 +3/+3/+3, round 3 +3/+3/+3, round 4 +4/+3/+2, round 5 +3/+3/+3. Passes both tests.
